cause: Create-dialog validation did not cover document lint/JSON-mode saves; not all form parameters were statically checked.
fixes: ASCII resource key, schema, identifiers, field registration, rule shapes/limits, percentages and bucketing checked before saving.
Segment and Flag constraints share typed operand validation; server remains authoritative for referenced object existence and full RE2 syntax.
Invalid JSON-mode saves report persistent errors and retain input.
Incomplete model-allowlist and guardrail rows are rejected instead of silently filtered.
Metric definitions, experiment numbers, slug formats, token scopes and rollout step fields receive local validation.

browser.newChineseKey: Native constraint validation blocked submission and kept the dialog open.
browser.jsonChineseKey: Actual save handler issued zero PUT requests; error shown and invalid input kept.
browser.simulatedBackend400: Actual save handler displayed rejection, retained Chinese displayName, and showed no success notification.

limits: Permissions, cross-document references, cycles, live revisions and final server parsing remain server-side validations.
Browser rejection scenario used a mocked 400 response; it did not mutate server data.
